notes: v1 = uniform 2.0 m (release 261105). v2 becomes default from the next CoMaps release after 261105. Copernicus-only leaves entirely below 60N use 5.0 m under v2; >=60N and all other Mapterhorn classes keep 2.0 m.

2.description: Copernicus-only + lat_max < 60 uses 5.0 m; otherwise 2.0 m.

mapterhorn_class_method: scripts/mwm/lib/elevation_policy.py::classify_mapterhorn_leaf — prefix rules from Mapterhorn source coverage (national LiDAR / aalv+nosvalbard 20 m / mixed overseas / glo30-only). Regenerate by re-running classification over countries.txt leaf ids after reviewing download.mapterhorn.com attribution / source-catalog.
lat_max_method: Prefer per-leaf lat_max from dump stats (max road-point latitude). Fallback heuristics in leaf_below_60n() treat northern Scandinavia/Russia/Canada/Alaska/etc. as not-below-60.

classes.high_res_20m: National 20 m DTM (Latvia aalv, Norway_Svalbard nosvalbard)
classes.mixed: Partial high-res / overseas mix (Australia, Canada, microstates, Portugal_Islands, …)
